newsitem.title: FINLAND: M-SERLA EYES EARLY-DEC TISSUE LISTING.
newsitem.headline: M-SERLA EYES EARLY-DEC TISSUE LISTING.

text.p: Finnish forest industry group Metsa-Serla Oy said on Thursday the planned bourse listing of its tissue paper unit was likely to take place early in December.

"The listing will be a topical issue around independence day," Metsa-Serla financing director Ari Martonen told a news conference on the company's first-half results. The Finnish independence day is December 6.
Metsa-Serla announced on June 18 it was considering a separate Helsinki bourse listing for the tissue paper unit, which in 1996 had net sales of 1.84 billion markka.
In the interim report, Metsa-Serla repeated that it intended to retain majority ownership in the new company.
